snippet.title: Kritter - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The free demo is available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454700/Kritter?utm_source=ytgp3
Don't hesitate to add it to your wishlist ;)

Kritter is a top-down action game blending roguelite, hack’n slash and base-building elements.
Protect M.Ark, your talking spaceship. Fight against monsters as well as time itself. Explore and grow stronger to escape an infernal time loop.
Are you prepared enough for the next assault ?

Kritter is the second game from the independant studio LJF Games, composed of Tom and Bastien, two friends from childhood.
If Hades, Overcooked, Pikmin and DomeKeeper had a baby it would be Kritter.

Learn more:
